## Target/function case feasibility proposal delivered — 2026-11-05

Under continuation-plan package 6, a **proposed narrow human MDM2–p53 structural-reference case** is ready for investigator choice. Primary anchors: [1YCR official deposition metadata](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1YCR), [revision history](https://www.rcsb.org/versions/1YCR), and [Kussie et al. 1996](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8875929/). A known peptide complex supports a reference exercise; it does not validate a new generated binder or therapeutic.

The local brief `devguide/target_case_mdm2_reference_proposal.md` separates:
1. **T0 identity/structural-reference qualification:** a proposed future order using MolSysMT for all molecular-format, selection/mapping and geometry operations. Pin actual coordinate/validation bytes, observed/deposited/chemical states, assembly and nonperiodic boundary. No coordinates have been downloaded/prepared or calculations performed.
2. **T1 peptide-recognition evaluation:** not implementation-ready; no selected qualified peptide-capable evaluator or matched biochemical binding panel. An eventual binding endpoint retains its assay, units and chemical context; native-complex geometry does not certify affinity/displacement.
3. **Later design/utility comparison:** a separate scientific commission. HydrAMP AMP conditioning, Macrel AMP/hemolysis scores and a stored target name do not supply target-aware design.

The full p28 target+CPP+anticancer portfolio recommendation is retained. The narrower reference is a separate proposed subproblem related to the MDM2/MDMX compass, with a different molecule; no p28/ATSP-7041 equivalence, new CPP identifier or selected model is asserted. Cellular entry, MDMX selectivity, p53-pathway phenotype and anticancer effectiveness stay unassessed.

Bounded owner inspection finds MolSysMT public conversion/get/selection and distance/contact/RMSD surfaces. MolSysViewer is the optional rendering owner. DockingMT's committed and concurrently edited READMEs agree on a **protein/small-molecule supported starting profile**; peptide-docking qualification is not established. No sibling code or geometry implementation is copied into PeptideMT, and no confirmed missing T0 API justifies a speculative provider issue.

Exact local source snapshots: MolSysMT `71fbe4f46d3c70e4e973c8025f01752a8c9b1084` (122 behind fetched main), MolSysViewer `73a6f388e09146650349dfe83564ae318ba20298` (111 behind), DockingMT `1837eecb32ba87e5e78697ac667f9d5a7de9c3ae` plus preserved concurrent documentation/examples. Actual read-file hashes distinguish worktree observations from committed source. No pull/stash/merge or shared-environment changes; these are source observations, not installed runtime qualification.

The wwPDB [archive policy](https://www.wwpdb.org/about/usage-policies) covers archive data under CC0; source attribution is retained. File hashes, per-chain observed mappings and chemical admission remain future work. Direct REST metadata reads were inaccessible through the web tool; official entry/history pages and the primary abstract suffice for the cited feasibility facts, without treating access failure as data absence.

**Recommended decision:** choose/reject the narrow reference case; if chosen, prepare only its concrete T0 work order first. The case, chemistry choices, thresholds, model or execution are **not accepted** by this memo. T0 success cannot count as predictive recognition or completion of target-aware peptide design. Existing D35/M1–M8 and scientific acceptance persist.

Separate product output: final dev9 review/commit proposal in https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/4#issuecomment-6677281002; no new commit. Combined exact receipt `devguide/evidence/target_case_mdm2_reference_review.json`, SHA-256 `ae8de9fa245efc378930337fad15bb34d9d81eb895899cb6d667981712a62ccd`. Current local navigation and this existing queue are updated; no new issue, scientific worker, models, GPU, publication or third-party contact. This issue remains partial for actual utility/target work.
